note: Allein lebt auch der Gui laut Profil ganz natürlich: Einzelgänger und Paare suchen sich einen Apex-Fleischfresser als Begleiter, reiten an seiner Seite und lernen seine Rufe. Das ist der Trauerdrongo. Die zeternde Elsternschar tritt zurück, das Grauhörnchen bleibt: Wo dein Riese rastet, kletterst du den höchsten Stamm hinauf.

analogs.covers: Solo life: a lone rider that attaches itself to a big animal, copies its calls and lives off what it stirs up and leaves behind
Body and stamina: a tireless trunk climber that races up the tallest tree nearby whenever danger comes

solo.headline: A drongo that picked a giant, on a squirrel's legs: you ride an Apex carnivore through the forests, copy its calls and race up the nearest trunk when it gets dangerous.
solo.playsLike: You are a Gui: wherever your giant rests, you climb the tallest trunk nearby. Alone you choose an Apex carnivore as your companion. You follow it with soft chirps until it has tolerated you for half a day, then you latch onto its side, ride along and learn its calls. You never help it: when it enters an engagement you let go, hide silently and only cheer it up afterwards. You eat carrion, insects and critters, hunt Juvenile-and-younger Deinonychus, Latenivenatrix, Psittacosaurus and Struthiomimus with copied calls as a lure, and chase Rhamphorhynchus. You flee from anything you cannot hunt and from Hatzegopteryx, Quetzalcoatlus, Megalania, Kelenken, Thalassodromeus and Tropeognathus. Other Microraptor near your companion get a ground challenge in your own voice.

why.text: Solitary Microraptor “may claim a carnivore companion” and “only attempt to create bonds with Apex Carnivores”. Fork-tailed drongos attach themselves to meerkats, babblers and big grazers and follow them all day.
Once allowed to latch on, it begins to “pick up on the calls of the carnivore” and mimics them back. Drongos copy the calls of the animals they live with.
On a hunt it may “utilize the calls of other species in an attempt to distract their prey”, the way a drongo's false alarm calls make meerkats drop their food.
Solitary Microraptor find “increased happiness in following other species about” and switch companions “on a whim”, just as drongos change hosts during the day.
It still lives up high: it sleeps in short bursts “always high up in a tree or cliff”, and as a Gui it climbs the tallest trunks without tiring, as a grey squirrel does.

notLike: Drongos are fearless and mob eagles; a Microraptor flees at the first sign of aggression and leaves its companion the moment an engagement starts.
Drongos catch insects in flight; Microraptor glides from trunk to trunk and finds its food on the ground and in the trees.
solo.summary: Solo bist du ein Trauerdrongo mit den Beinen eines Grauhörnchens. Du folgst einem Apex-Fleischfresser mit leisem Zirpen, bis er dich einen halben Tag geduldet hat, dann klammerst du dich an seine Seite und reitest mit ihm durch die großen Wälder. Rastet er, kletterst du den höchsten Stamm in der Nähe hinauf, denn als Gui hast du dort oben die meiste Ausdauer. In seine Kämpfe und Jagden mischst du dich nie ein: Beginnt ein Kampf, springst du ab, versteckst dich still im Baum und munterst ihn erst danach mit Cheer Up auf. Du lebst von Aas, Insekten und Kleintieren und lockst mit nachgeahmten Rufen Eltern von ihren Küken weg. Andere Microraptor an deinem Begleiter forderst du am Boden mit deiner eigenen Stimme heraus.
